questions.title: How would you like to pleasantly surprise or make your partner happy in the future? Maybe you have a dream you would like to fulfill for him/her?
Share with your partner: "I would like to feel more of your support in…, then I would feel more confident and calm."
Describe how you see your life in the future you are striving for. What values and dreams would you like to realize?
What would you like your partner to understand better about you? Why is it important for your comfort and relationship?
Share with your partner: "I would like us to talk more often about topics such as…"
Complete the sentence: "I would like to apologize for…. This happened/is happening not because you…, but because I…"
At what moments do you stop feeling happy in the relationship? What could your partner do to help you in such situations?
Ask your partner: "What can I do to make you feel happier more often?"
Make a list of five points together and discuss: "In our relationship, it is especially important for me that you…"
Share with your partner: "It upsets/hurts me when you…. At such moments I feel… and I think that…"
What social norms and rules put pressure on you and force you to do more than you would like?
What prevents you from reaching a new income level? What steps can you take to change this?
What qualities that you don’t have attract you the most in other people?
What mistakes, similar to your parents’ mistakes, do you fear the most?
Complete the sentence: "If I had more time and money, I would…"
Does cheating always mean the end of a relationship? Why or why not? Share your experience: how has cheating affected your life and perception of relationships?

Which qualities of a partner upset you the most and why? It could be inability to make decisions, fear of intimacy, unwillingness to grow, refusal to earn money, or inability to discuss feelings and desires.
Does a man’s success depend solely on himself, or does the woman beside him play an important role? Why do you think so?
When it comes to spending time with your partner’s friends, what makes you uncomfortable? Why?
Continue the phrase: "My father is a man who… What irritates me about him the most is…"
In what place do you dream of having sex? Why does this thought inspire you?
What do you think you are lacking to become the perfect partner in bed?
Are you intrigued by the idea of covering yourselves with something tasty and licking it off each other in turns?
Complete the sentence: "Women most often feel a strong sexual attraction to men who…"
What gives you more pleasure: seducing or being seduced?
If a tabloid wrote an article about your personal life, what would the headline be?
How do your inner worries and conflicts affect what happens around you? Have there been examples in your life that confirm this?
Is there something that makes you feel embarrassed or self-conscious? Why does it cause you discomfort?
What aspects of yourself would you like your partner to better understand? Why is this important for your comfort and our relationship?
Share with your partner: “I wish we could discuss … more often.”
How would you like your partner to address you, or on the contrary, how would you prefer not to be called? Even if it sounds unusual.
How often—over a week, a month, or a year—do you shift from believing in yourself to complete self-doubt? What helps you cope with these states?
To what extent do other people’s perceptions of you match who you really are? Where do the differences show?
When you feel like giving up, what usually leads to it? How could your partner support you in such moments?
Complete the sentence: “When I want intimacy and my partner doesn’t share my mood, I feel…, because… It would be easier for me if…”
Complete the sentence: “My favorite sex position is…, because…”
Do you think a woman’s sexuality depends only on herself, or also on the man who is with her?
What turns you on more: unavailability or persistent seduction?
Confess: do you have a secret habit you carefully hide from your partner? Tell them about it honestly.
Confess: have you ever been jealous of something in your partner's life? What was it and why didn't you say anything?
Confess: which moment in your relationship would you erase from memory, and why does it still bother you?
Truth: name one thing your partner regularly does that secretly annoys you. Why have you kept quiet about it?
Truth: if you could change one decision in your relationship, what would it be and how would things be different?
Truth: what compliment do you most want to hear from your partner, but have never had the courage to ask for?
Never have I ever... pretended to be asleep to avoid a conversation. Have you? Why do you prefer silence over talking?
Never have I ever... read my partner's messages without them knowing. Have you? What made you do it — or what stopped you?
Who between us would want a pet first, and what kind? Guess each other's answer, then compare.
Who between us forgives faster, and who holds onto hurt longer? Do you agree with your partner's opinion of you?
